design_description: The Bro Beans away kit takes a clean, understated approach, built around a warm cream base with black detailing and a subtle retro-football influence. The shirt is predominantly cream, with very fine tone-on-tone vertical pinstripes running down the body. They give the otherwise minimal base some structure while remaining discreet enough to keep the overall look elegant. Black provides all the key contrast: the collar, sleeve cuffs, shoulder detailing, logos and typography. The collar has a slightly classic shape with a small opening at the front, reinforcing the vintage character of the design. Thin black shoulder stripes continue that visual language. The front is intentionally simple. The Bro Beans wordmark is centered prominently on the chest, with the manufacturer branding and team crest positioned conventionally above it. The restrained palette keeps all three elements cohesive rather than competing for attention. On the back, the cream base remains almost completely clean. A large black player name and number with a fine cream/light outline becomes the focal point, while dark side panels add definition to the silhouette and connect visually with the sleeve and collar trims. Overall, it is a minimal cream-and-black kit with subtle vintage cues: clean pinstripes, traditional trim detailing and strong monochrome typography give Bro Beans a simple but distinctive identity.
